crossRefs.note: Surely he has borne our sickness and carried our suffering; yet we considered him plagued, struck by God, and afflicted.

translations.web: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.
translations.bsb: But if he has wronged you in any way or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
translations.kjv: If he hath wronged thee, or oweth thee ought, put that on mine account;
translations.asv: But if he hath wronged the at all, or oweth thee aught, put that to mine account;
